newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office Products to hold conference.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office Products to hold conference.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said on Wednesday that it will hold a conference call Thursday, April 10 at 1030 EDT, to discuss corporate developments in response to activity of the company's stock.
U.S. Office Products shares fell 1-1/4 to 21-1/8 on volume of 5.68 million shares on Wednesday.
The conference call will be hosted by chairman and chief executive officer Jonathan Ledecky, the company said.
To participate in the call from the United States and Canada, dial 1-800-283-1485 and ask to be included in the "U.S. Office Products Conference Call," the company said.
Callers in Washington can dial 703/736-7226 to be connected with the call, U.S. Office Products said.
International callers can use the following numbers to be connected: United Kingdom, 050 089 2521; New Zealand, 0800 44 2965; Australia, 1 800 14 0200; and Switzerland, 155 2538, the company said.
